verdict.rationale: Linear's docs say feedback can be analyzed in bulk with Linear Agent, and that customer feedback is automatically turned into issues that are routed, labeled, and prioritized. Separately, customer requests can be filtered by count, tier, revenue, and size to identify high-impact work, but that impact surfacing is manual filtering, not AI. The AI analysis evidence is a single brief mention with no detail on how it declutters or ranks opportunities. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how Linear Agent clusters or deduplicates raw feedback, AI-driven ranking of the most impactful opportunities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities

citations.quote: analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
